answer: An adversary running 99 aliases hence needs 141 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in vertex, expire in meadow, and cedar lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1579 identities would post 4205 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
